name: FastTracker-Benchmark-MOT
description:
FastTracker-MOT Benchmark
	

This dataset is a derivative of FastTracker-Benchmark.

	
		
		What's different?
	

Changes:

Extracted frames from videos and saved according to MOT format
Fixed critical errors in original Ground Truth.
Added seqinfo.ini files similar to MOT17 dataset with FPS information.

Example:

  




	
	
	
		A new benchmark dataset comprising diverse vehicle classes with frame-level tracking annotation introduced in paper: FastTracker: Real-Time and Accurate Visual… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Fleyderer/FastTracker-Benchmark-MOT.
evaluation_method: MOTA / IDF1 / HOTA (standard multi-object tracking metrics)
reputation: Derivative, task-focused MOT dataset with limited but growing use for vehicle tracking; not as widely adopted as canonical MOTChallenge datasets.
